title: StudyHub topic catalog
description: metadata/topics/<category>.json — every topic in one category. The app fetches these to build navigation, search, filters and progress tracking.

category.description: Must equal the category id this file is registered under in metadata/categories.json.

id.description: Globally unique, PERMANENT identifier. Used for URLs, progress and bookmarks. Never change it once published.

slug.description: Folder name of the topic. Folder path = content/<category>/[<subcategory>/]<slug>/.

subcategory.description: Subcategory id declared under the category, or null if the category has none.

type.description: Selects the lesson template and how the app presents the topic.

description.description: One or two sentences. Shown on cards and used by search.

estimatedMinutes.description: Approximate time to study content.md once.

order.description: Position within its subcategory (or category). Suggested learning order.

files.description: Which markdown files exist in the topic folder. The app only requests files listed here.

visualizer.description: Id of an interactive visualizer for this topic, or null. Setting it marks the topic as an interactive-visualization candidate; ids are registered in docs/visualizers.md. The app shows a visualizer only once a module with this id exists.

status.description: Drafts stay hidden in the app.

updated.description: Date of the last meaningful content change (YYYY-MM-DD).
